001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.AlarmStatusResponse;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.AlertStatusResponse;
008
009/**
010 * Written when the pump annunciates an active alert, alarm or CGM alert: in the same second as
011 * the activation for most ids, then again at multiples of about 5 minutes for as long as the
012 * notification stays unacknowledged.
013 *
014 * <p>For alerts and alarms, all 1489 records examined (six pumps, Mobi and t:slim X2) follow an
015 * AlertActivated / AlarmActivated record with the same {@link #getCategory() category} and
016 * {@link #getNotificationId() id} on the same pump, and none comes after that notification's
017 * AlertAck / AlarmAck. CGM alerts ({@link AamCategory#CGM_ALERT}, seen only on the t:slim X2)
018 * follow a CGM alert activation with the same id; after an acknowledgement they resume later
019 * (60 minutes later for CGM alert 2, then every 5 minutes), consistent with a CGM alert repeat
020 * setting. The 2022 t:slim X2 captures contain no records of this type.
021 *
022 * <p>The class name is provisional: Tandem's cloud export and the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum
023 * do not name this opcode. Bytes 11, 12-13, 18 and 19 are not understood and are exposed raw;
024 * bytes 16-17 and 20-25 were zero in all 1680 records examined.
025 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/147.
026 */
027
028/**
029 * History log record Alert/Alarm Annunciation, opCode 434, size 26.
030 *
031 * <br>
032 *
033 * Written when the pump annunciates an active alert, alarm or CGM alert: in the same second as
034 * the activation for most ids, then again at multiples of about 5 minutes for as long as the
035 * notification stays unacknowledged.
036 *
037 * <p>For alerts and alarms, all 1489 records examined (six pumps, Mobi and t:slim X2) follow an
038 * AlertActivated / AlarmActivated record with the same {@link #getCategory() category} and
039 * {@link #getNotificationId() id} on the same pump, and none comes after that notification's
040 * AlertAck / AlarmAck. CGM alerts ({@link AamCategory#CGM_ALERT}, seen only on the t:slim X2)
041 * follow a CGM alert activation with the same id; after an acknowledgement they resume later
042 * (60 minutes later for CGM alert 2, then every 5 minutes), consistent with a CGM alert repeat
043 * setting. The 2022 t:slim X2 captures contain no records of this type.
044 *
045 * <p>The class name is provisional: Tandem's cloud export and the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum
046 * do not name this opcode. Bytes 11, 12-13, 18 and 19 are not understood and are exposed raw;
047 * bytes 16-17 and 20-25 were zero in all 1680 records examined.
048 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/147.
049 *
050 * 
051 * <table border='1'>
052 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
053 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>434</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
054 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Alert/Alarm Annunciation"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
055 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>""</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
056 * </table>
057 */@HistoryLogProps(
058    opCode = 434,
059    displayName = "Alert/Alarm Annunciation",
060    internalName = ""
061)
062public class AamAnnunciationHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
063
064    private int categoryId;
065    private int unknown11;
066    private int unknown12;
067    private long notificationId;
068    private int unknown18;
069    private int unknown19;
070
071    public AamAnnunciationHistoryLog() {}
072    public AamAnnunciationHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int categoryId, int unknown11, int unknown12, long notificationId, int unknown18, int unknown19) {
073        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
074        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, categoryId, unknown11, unknown12, notificationId, unknown18, unknown19);
075        this.categoryId = categoryId;
076        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
077        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
078        this.notificationId = notificationId;
079        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
080        this.unknown19 = unknown19;
081    }
082
083    public AamAnnunciationHistoryLog(int categoryId, int unknown11, int unknown12, long notificationId, int unknown18, int unknown19) {
084        this(0, 0, categoryId, unknown11, unknown12, notificationId, unknown18, unknown19);
085    }
086
087    public int typeId() {
088        return 434;
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * <table border="1">
093     * <caption>Parsed fields for AamAnnunciationHistoryLog:</caption>
094     * <tr><td><code>categoryId</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
095     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
096     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
097     * <tr><td><code>notificationId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
098     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td><code>unknown19</code></td><td><code>raw[19] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
100     * </table>
101     */
102    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
103        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
104        this.cargo = raw;
105        parseBase(raw);
106        this.categoryId = raw[10] & 0xFF;
107        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
108        this.unknown12 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
109        this.notificationId = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
110        this.unknown18 = raw[18] & 0xFF;
111        this.unknown19 = raw[19] & 0xFF;
112    }
113
114    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int categoryId, int unknown11, int unknown12, long notificationId, int unknown18, int unknown19) {
115        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
116            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(434, 0),
117            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
118            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
119            new byte[]{ (byte) categoryId, (byte) unknown11 },
120            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown12),
121            Bytes.toUint32(notificationId),
122            new byte[]{ (byte) unknown18, (byte) unknown19 }));
123    }
124
125    /**
126     * @return byte 10, the raw notification category (see {@link #getCategory()})
127     */
128    public int getCategoryId() {
129        return categoryId;
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * @return the notification category, or null for a value not observed yet
134     */
135    public AamCategory getCategory() {
136        return AamCategory.fromId(categoryId);
137    }
138
139    /**
140     * The id of the notification being annunciated, in the id space of its
141     * {@link #getCategory() category}: {@link AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType} for alerts,
142     * {@link AlarmStatusResponse.AlarmResponseType} for alarms, and the alertId of
143     * {@link CgmAlertActivatedDexHistoryLog} for CGM alerts. Every id matched the activation
144     * record it followed.
145     *
146     * <p>Id 0 is a real alert, LOW_INSULIN_ALERT, not an empty slot: it is frequent because the
147     * low-insulin alert is re-annunciated every few minutes until it is acknowledged.
148     *
149     * @return the alert, alarm or CGM alert id (bytes 14-17)
150     */
151    public long getNotificationId() {
152        return notificationId;
153    }
154
155    /**
156     * @return the alert type when {@link #getCategory()} is {@link AamCategory#ALERT}, else null
157     */
158    public AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType getAlertResponseType() {
159        if (getCategory() != AamCategory.ALERT) {
160            return null;
161        }
162        return AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType.fromSingularId(notificationId);
163    }
164
165    /**
166     * @return the alarm type when {@link #getCategory()} is {@link AamCategory#ALARM}, else null
167     */
168    public AlarmStatusResponse.AlarmResponseType getAlarmResponseType() {
169        if (getCategory() != AamCategory.ALARM) {
170            return null;
171        }
172        return AlarmStatusResponse.AlarmResponseType.fromSingularId(notificationId);
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * Byte 11, meaning unknown. Together with {@link #getUnknown12()} and {@link #getUnknown18()}
177     * it is constant for a given category and id across all 1680 records: 1 for alerts 0, 2, 3,
178     * 17, 26 and 54; 2 for alerts 4, 11, 13, 14, 50 and 51; 3 for alarms; 0, 1 or 2 for CGM
179     * alerts depending on the id.
180     *
181     * @return byte 11
182     */
183    public int getUnknown11() {
184        return unknown11;
185    }
186
187    /**
188     * Bytes 12-13, meaning unknown: 0 for alerts, 10 for alarms 3, 12 and 18 but 0 for alarm 23,
189     * and 20, 30 or 40 for CGM alerts depending on the id.
190     *
191     * @return the uint16 at bytes 12-13
192     */
193    public int getUnknown12() {
194        return unknown12;
195    }
196
197    /**
198     * Byte 18, meaning unknown: 4 or 5 for alerts (following {@link #getUnknown11()}), 6 for
199     * alarms, 8-14 for CGM alerts depending on the id.
200     *
201     * @return byte 18
202     */
203    public int getUnknown18() {
204        return unknown18;
205    }
206
207    /**
208     * Byte 19, meaning unknown. For alerts it matched the pump's alert annunciation setting
209     * ({@code PumpGlobalsResponse.alertAnnun}) wherever one was polled near the record, on three
210     * pumps; for alarms it did not track {@code alarmAnnun} on the t:slim X2, so it stays raw.
211     *
212     * @return byte 19
213     */
214    public int getUnknown19() {
215        return unknown19;
216    }
217
218    /**
219     * Values of byte 10, confirmed by matching every record's id against the activation record
220     * of that category it followed.
221     */
222    public enum AamCategory {
223        ALERT(3),
224        ALARM(4),
225        CGM_ALERT(6),
226        ;
227
228        private final int id;
229        AamCategory(int id) {
230            this.id = id;
231        }
232        public int id() {
233            return id;
234        }
235        public static AamCategory fromId(int id) {
236            for (AamCategory c : values()) {
237                if (c.id == id) return c;
238            }
239            return null;
240        }
241    }
242}
